So whoever the examiner is from wherever, marking is reliable in this type of test. On the other hand, essay tests focus on logical thinking, analytical skill and creativity in presenting an idea, which are very important for all learners for their intellectual development. However, marking is highly subjective in this type of tests. Two examiners may award two different marks for the same type of answers, or even the same examiner may award different marks for the same level of answer if marking at two different times or on two different days. Therefore, scoring of essay tests is not reliable. Thus the two types of tests focus on different aspects, and both have their distinctive merits and demerits and both are needed.
